description: This file contains functions for verifying the URL resolution of the '/api/users' endpoint in a development and testing context, including functions to generate the URL with specific organization IDs and log the results for verification purposes.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the '/api/users' endpoint, optionally overriding the organization ID for testing purposes, and performs environment-specific logging and validation.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
